punchline: He could not decode the English, but he could read the wind turbine on the cover.
thirty_sec: Sent home from school, William Kamkwamba went to the small library in Wimbe. His English was too weak for the physics books, so he studied the diagrams. A textbook called Using Energy showed that turbines could pump water and generate electricity.
question: Which subject have you postponed because you cannot understand all of it, and what small part can you?
key_contrast: The part you cannot read versus the part you can.
